registered_after: AR2 positive C and negative PR1; before W1 SVD or PR2 scores
inputs: actual V1 after Q1 and before FFN0; exact cached W1 QDQ, checkpoint b1, cached s2, W2 and preexisting gate
factorization: data-independent randomized SVD of FP32 cached W1[out,in], seed20261020, q544, niter3
prediction: FP32 V1@V_r@diag(S_r)@U_r.T+b1, cast BF16; GELU(tanh); FP32 divide by s2, cast BF16; native HiF4 Q2(force_fp32=True)
score: FP32 per-original-group W2 projection and gate; FP64 squared-energy reduction, as frozen AR2 C
energy_residual: donor-only groupwise weighted LS of (true_C-raw_C) on e=mean(V1^2)/donor_mean_energy; add e_test*beta, clip nonnegative
donor: task0 opposite seed, same step/expert/block20; no test V2/H/Z/Delta enters predictor or calibration
support: 216 original groups64; top108 with stable group-ID ties
gain_fit: policy-specific bias-free FP32 signal versus dense signal on donor actual V2, never a test target
primary_gate: proxy<=0.8 random and <=0.9 C_static and <=1.1 true C_dynamic; >=3/4 scopes with both seeds and steps independently per source
selection: minimum rank passing task0 Fit gate; raw preferred if both modes pass that rank; report task6 Validation for this choice. Other validation ranks are sensitivity only. No Fit pass means route fails.
control_use: operator/score verification only, excluded from candidate and rank selection; dense oracle explicitly computes full FFN0
precision: GPU FP32 prediction; native CPU BF16 projection primary and matched FP32 control
deployment_status: row-wise diagnostic only; score cost, QDQ, tile sharing, full sparse CUDA FFN and video acceptance remain unmeasured
